# EQL-Pytorch (minimal vendored copy)

These files are derived from [EQL-Pytorch](https://github.com/lkmklsmn/EQL-Pytorch) and are used by SyNF:

- `eqlearner.py` — Equation Learner network
- `l0_dense.py` — L0 regularization layers
- `custom_functions.py` — Custom torch/sympy operators

Only the core modules required for inference and training are included.
